summary: The note is a short biographical entry for Ali Mitgutsch, born Alfons Mitgutsch on August 21, 1935 in Munich, Germany. He is described as a German author of picture books and a professional advertising illustrator. The note identifies him as the father of the Wimmelbilder (busy picture) books.
one_line: Ali Mitgutsch is a German picture-book author and advertising illustrator known as the father of Wimmelbilder books.
